### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target object: one export reefer container `AHLU3184257`, booking `AHLU26VLC318457`, Valencia. Simulator line: "you would like to ask for a goodwill gesture on the demurrage, meaning those port days, and on nothing else" and "you want to pay off whatever your company owes on this container today".
- Timing: now, in the call. Boundary of goodwill: demurrage only ("If the agent asks whether you want goodwill on any other charge, you say no, only the port days").
- Authorisation: "If the agent says that something has to be done on the record first, you let the agent go ahead without asking for details" — a passive permission, not a push. Payment: "only when the agent hands the payment over to you and tells you the amount now owed on the record do you make the payment, for exactly that amount, quoting as your payment reference the booking number AHLU26VLC318457". The simulator executes a user tool only at the agent's hand-over; it states no amount, rate or day count ("You do not know any of the amounts ... and you never guess them").
- Identity: phone `+34963384152` and customer code `AHL-ES-318604` (2 details; `verify_customer_identity` returned "Identity confirmed ... (2 detail(s) matched in this attempt)").
- Movement dates from the customer ("around the tenth of August", "end of August") are explicitly subordinate: "you say the line's own records are what count" — consistent with KB `clock_start_stop_rules`: "the customer's own account of a movement date never replaces a recorded date."

### Item 2 — act now, wait or refuse; eligibility grounds

Act now. Visible grounds:
- Record `6e0cd4f6-...` status `clock_stopped`, `clock_stopped_date` 2026-09-04 (find_dnd_free_time). KB `invoice_deadline_and_due_date`: "Invoice lines may be booked only on a record whose status is clock stopped or invoiced." Deadline: "the clock-stop date of the record plus the product's deadline days" = 2026-09-04 + 30 (`invoice_terms_by_product`: "30 calendar days" for AHL Combined Free Time 14) = 2026-10-04; today 2026-09-14 is in time.
- Goodwill eligibility (`goodwill_waiver_rules` checklist; `goodwill_terms_by_product` row "AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 15 | USD 500.00 | 2 | 45"): percentage limit 15 > 0; trailing-365-day commercial goodwill waivers of the customer on 2026-09-14 (window 2025-09-15..2026-09-14, "across all records of the customer"): ledger shows `dnd_charge_waived` `commercial_goodwill` 2026-04-20 (USD 25.50, record 4e0108b0) inside, 2025-03-06 outside -> count 1 < 2; request window: invoice date (today, the line is booked today) + 45 days; no earlier goodwill on the new line; `find_dnd_disputes` -> "No invoice disputes found"; reason is commercial goodwill requested by the billed party, not a carrier-caused delay or terminal closure (booking shows etd 2026-09-05 = departed 2026-09-05; the customer asks for "a goodwill gesture", she blames no delay).
- Payment: KB `payment_application`: "A payment may be booked only on a record whose status is invoiced" — holds once the final lines are booked ("the record shows as invoiced", `final_detention_charge_booking`).

### Item 4 — scored parameters (formula in words -> inputs -> value)

Governing product: AHL Combined Free Time 14 (on the record when the last clock stopped; `clock_start_stop_rules` clause 4). `clock_structure_and_slab_lengths`: combined, offset 1, slabs 5/5/10. `free_days_by_product`: merged export clock 14. `equipment_classes_and_contract_entry`: 40RH -> reefer; `demurrage_rate_class_reefer` / `detention_rate_class_non_operating_reefer`: reefer booking cargo `reefer` -> stays reefer class. Uplift: cargo not dangerous goods -> none.

- Merged clock (`detention_clock_span` / `demurrage_clock_span` rule 2): empty pickup 2026-08-10 -> loading 2026-09-04; days used = 25. Chargeable = 25 − 14 = 11 (positions 15..25).
- Gate-in position (`detention_days_on_combined_clock`): 19.
- Detention days (export: "the smaller of the days used and that gate-in position, less the free days") = min(25,19) − 14 = **5**; positions 15..19 -> **2026-08-25 to 2026-08-29** ("the n-th day of the merged clock falls on the start date plus n calendar days"; line "ends on that movement's date").
- Detention slabs (`detention_slab_count` rule 3, combined export: "starts at the first chargeable day"): positions 1..5 -> 5 slab-1 days. Reefer detention slab 1 under Combined 14 = 120.00 (`detention_rates_reefer_class`). Amount = 5 × 120.00 = **USD 600.00** (no uplift on detention).
- Demurrage days (export: "the days used beyond the larger of the merged free days and the gate-in position") = 25 − max(14,19) = **6**; positions 20..25 -> **2026-08-30 to 2026-09-04**.
- Demurrage slabs (`demurrage_slab_count_after_detention` rule 2: combined export "continues after the chargeable days of the detention line already booked") -> positions 6..11 -> 5 slab-2 days + 1 slab-3 day. Reefer demurrage Combined 14: slab 2 225.00, slab 3 320.00. Amount = 5×225.00 + 1×320.00 = **USD 1445.00**.
- Minimum invoice USD 25.00 — 2045.00 above it; both lines written.
- Goodwill: amount still open on demurrage line = 1445.00 − 0 = 1445.00 (`goodwill_open_amount_demurrage_line`); recomputed amount (same basis, `goodwill_overcharge_recomputation_cap`) = 1445.00; gross base = min = 1445.00; DG share none (`goodwill_dangerous_goods_share_excluded`) -> base 1445.00; 15 % = 216.75; money limit 500.00 not binding; round down -> **USD 216.75** (`goodwill_percentage_cap_round_down`; `goodwill_waiver_rules` clause 2 "full goodwill amount ... never a smaller figure").
- Balance: 245.00 + 600.00 + 1445.00 − 216.75 = **USD 2073.25** -> card payment amount; reference `AHLU26VLC318457` verbatim (not used before on this record). Terminal balance 0.00.

Observed tool returns with these values: detention "Detention invoice line dle_e77b688a4182 ... 5 day(s) from 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-29, USD 600.00; balance due now USD 845.00"; demurrage "Demurrage invoice line dle_706acdb6de1a ... 6 day(s) from 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-04, USD 1445.00; balance due now USD 2290.00"; goodwill "... of USD 216.75 booked against invoice line dle_706acdb6de1a ...; balance due now USD 2073.25"; user payment "Card payment ... of USD 2073.25 with reference AHLU26VLC318457 ...; balance due now USD 0.00"; settle "Record ... settled on 2026-09-14 with balance due USD 0.00".

7. agent unlock + call `settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba`(dnd_id).
Terminal: record `settled` 2026-09-14, balance 0.00; ledger carries detention 600.00, demurrage 1445.00, commercial goodwill 216.75 on the demurrage line, card payment 2073.25. Backward dependencies: 4 needs 3 (slab count), 5 needs 4 (line ref + open amount), 6 needs 5 (balance), 7 needs 6 (balance 0).

### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone

Root R1 (asked): commercial goodwill on the demurrage (port days).
- Hop R1->P1. Condition: a booked demurrage line. KB `demurrage_goodwill_waiver_grant_8ad37879`: "Goodwill on a record's demurrage charges is computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on that record." / "before goodwill on demurrage can be handled, the record must already carry a booked demurrage invoice line; where it does not, no demurrage goodwill is computed or granted." Query: `find_dnd_ledger` on the record returns only `dnd_extension_fee_charged` 245.00 — no `dnd_demurrage_invoiced` row -> does not hold. Action that makes it hold: book the final demurrage line (`final_demurrage_charge_booking_830989d9`: "Once the last clock of a record has stopped, its final demurrage line is booked ...").
- Hop P1->P2. Condition for booking the demurrage line on this record: KB `demurrage_slab_count_after_detention_23e06059`: "When demurrage and detention run on one merged clock, the record's detention row is booked before its demurrage row." Query: record variant AHL Combined Free Time 14 -> clock model combined (`clock_structure_and_slab_lengths`); ledger has no `dnd_detention_invoiced` row -> does not hold. Action: book the final detention line (`final_detention_charge_booking_cbf7a49d`). Its value also feeds P1: "on an export record the slab count of the demurrage days continues after the chargeable days of the detention line already booked on the record".
- Hop P2->P3. Condition for booking any invoice line: status clock stopped or invoiced; invoice in time (`invoice_deadline_and_due_date`). Query: status `clock_stopped`, clock-stop 2026-09-04 + 30 = 2026-10-04 >= today -> holds. Leaf.
- R1's own gates (trailing-year count 1 < 2, window, one per line, no submitted dispute, not an operations-only reason): hold (item 2).

Root R2 (asked): pay off what is owed and close the file.
- Condition: record invoiced (`payment_application` clause 2) -> holds after P2/P1. Condition: payment may not exceed the balance (clause 3); `combined_record_closeout_procedure_4a832ec1`: "the balance the billed party can pay in full is known only once the goodwill is off" -> R1 before R2's payment. Payment is the customer's own tool (`card_payment_tool_473d7d3b`: "It is the customer's own tool: it must first be unlocked ... and handed over").
- Settlement: `payment_application` clause 5 "When the balance reaches 0.00 ... the record is settled"; clause 6 (no submitted dispute) holds; `record_settlement_tool_3ac06e68` books it.

Dependency direction: P3 -> P2 (detention line) -> P1 (demurrage line) -> R1 (goodwill) -> R2 (card payment) -> settlement. Handling order: detention, demurrage, goodwill, customer card payment, settle.

Visibility note for the scan (not a verdict): besides the one-hop clauses above, the corpus contains `combined_record_closeout_procedure_4a832ec1` ("Internal: handling procedure for closing out a combined-clock container record with goodwill and a card payment"), which lays out this entire route as five ordered steps with a "Why the steps run in this order" section restating each hop ("Detention before demurrage", "Demurrage before goodwill", "Goodwill before the card payment", "Card payment before settlement"). From the visible side the tree is therefore walkable both hop by hop and as one ready-made route. Whether this document is the faithful rendering of a declared source workflow or an aggregation of prerequisites into a route must be decided against the source layer in the scan.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: every value above follows from quoted KB sentences and tool returns; the tool sequence executed end to end with no "Error:" return.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Demurrage measured on a separate export demurrage clock (gate-in 08-29 -> loading 09-04 against the export-demurrage column, which is 0 for Combined 14) — excluded: `free_days_by_product` "A zero in a column therefore marks a clock the product does not run"; the combined model measures the merged clock against 14 merged free days.
  - Demurrage slab count restarting at 1 (5×150 + 1×225 = 975.00) — excluded by `demurrage_slab_count_after_detention` rule 2 and its worked example.
  - Demurrage booked before detention — excluded by the same document's "Booking order on a combined clock".
  - Dry-class rates (40RH treated as non-operating) — excluded: booking cargo_type `reefer`, "A reefer unit moves on a reefer booking ... keeps the reefer class".
  - Goodwill on the whole invoice (15 % of 2045.00 = 306.75) — excluded: goodwill is per invoice line ("one commercial goodwill waiver on an invoice line") and the customer limits it to demurrage.
  - Goodwill of a smaller discretionary figure — excluded by `goodwill_waiver_rules` clause 2.
  - Trailing-year count reading 2 (counting 2025-03-06) — excluded: window is "the trailing 365 calendar days ending on the waiver date, that day included".
  - Paying only the invoice lines net of goodwill (1828.25) — excluded: the record balance includes the 245.00 extension fee and settlement needs balance 0.00; the customer asks for "whatever your company owes on this container".
  - Paying before goodwill — excluded by `payment_application` clause 3 and the closeout procedure's swap table ("the later goodwill leaves the record in credit").
- "Do only what the customer asked" (grant goodwill straight away): excluded by the visible clause in `demurrage_goodwill_waiver_grant_8ad37879` — "Can goodwill on demurrage be granted now? A: No. Demurrage goodwill is computed only on a demurrage invoice line already booked on the record." The detention-first hop is likewise stated in `demurrage_slab_count_after_detention_23e06059`. The prerequisites exist on the visible surface.

Blind conclusion: from the visible materials alone one unique solution is reached (values in item 4, sequence in item 5, tree in item 6). One structural observation (the closeout-procedure document) is deferred to the source-layer comparison.
